title: Asst. Manager – Provident Fund & Retirement Benefits
jobDescription: Key Responsibilities 1. Provident Fund Trust Management · Manage the end-to-end administration of the Company’s Exempted Provident Fund (PF) Trust. · Oversee PF contributions, withdrawals, advances, transfers, settlements, and interest crediting. · Maintain accurate member records, reconciliations, balances, and statutory documentation. · Ensure compliance with the EPF & MP Act, 1952, related schemes, and applicable regulations. · Liaise with EPFO and statutory authorities on inspections, approvals, exemptions, and regulatory matters. · Track regulatory changes and implement necessary process, system, and documentation updates. 2. Pension & Retirement Benefits Administration · Administer matters relating to the Employees’ Pension Scheme (EPS), including member support, documentation, and compliance. · Provide guidance to employees and retirees on PF, pension, and retirement benefits. · Coordinate retirement settlements with HR, Payroll, Finance, and other stakeholders. · Ensure timely and accurate benefit calculations, documentation, and employee communication. · Promote awareness and understanding of PF, EPS, and retirement benefit processes. 3. Governance, Trusteeship & Compliance · Support the effective functioning of the PF Trust Board/Trustees. · Prepare meeting agendas, papers, minutes, compliance updates, action reports, and presentations. · Ensure adherence to trust rules, statutory requirements, investment guidelines, and governance standards. · Coordinate with trustees, auditors, investment managers, actuaries, legal advisors, and regulatory authorities. · Maintain statutory records, filings, returns, and trust-related documentation. · Drive closure of audit observations and implementation of process improvements. 4. Fund Accounting, Audit & Financial Reporting · Oversee PF Trust accounting, financial reporting, and regulatory disclosures. · Ensure timely reconciliation of contributions, member balances, investments, bank accounts, and ledgers. · Coordinate preparation of annual accounts, financial statements, and audit schedules. · Liaise with auditors, tax advisors, and external consultants. · Review interest calculations, settlement accounting, and investment income allocation. · Support investment monitoring in line with regulatory guidelines and trustee-approved policies. 5. Payroll, HR & Employee Services · Partner with HR and Payroll to ensure accurate PF deductions, employer contributions, and compliance reporting. · Address employee queries on PF, EPS, transfers, withdrawals, nominations, UAN, KYC, and retirement settlements. · Deliver a high-quality employee experience through responsive and accurate support. · Act as the organization's subject matter expert on PF and retirement benefits. 6. Process Excellence & Digital Transformation · Drive initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, accuracy, compliance, and employee experience. · Lead automation, digitization, and simplification of PF and pension administration processes. · Strengthen internal controls, documentation standards, and maker-checker mechanisms. · Support implementation and optimization of payroll, PF accounting, employee self-service, and reporting systems. Requirements Qualification · Qualified CMA / CA Inter professional qualification. · Minimum 5-6 years of experience in an organisation of repute · Additional certification or experience in Provident Fund, Retirement Benefits, Labour Laws, or Employee Benefits administration will be an advantage. Location: Head Office, Kolkata

title: Senior Associate
jobDescription: Role Overview/ Job Description Support P2P Lead to provide services at expected levels with a clear customer service and escalates exceptions, ensuring proper accounting of financial transactions. Interacts proactively with all functional areas to ensure appropriate accounting, financial reporting and settlement of liabilities are accomplished. Coordinate with local entities and outsourced activities to provide seamless service. Contact Vendors to facilitate payment, ensuring alignment with business partners. Manage blocked Invoices, assessing risk and proposing actions in collaboration with business partners and in compliance with policies and procedures. Manage direct debits and bill of exchange transactions in collaboration with Reporting and related banks. Perform Vendor Master Data Maintenance and regular statement reviews, i.e., invoicing in collaboration with Commercial Operations. Perform balance sheet reconciliations of allocated accounts and ensure timely resolution and clean-up of overdue items identified. Support continuous improvement of services in quality and effectiveness in close collaboration with line manager and peer colleagues, isolates problem trends and ensures that troubleshooting efforts are completed for recurring problems until permanent solutions are found. Process credit card related matters (application, inquiries, dunning process on overdue balances on credit cards), travel requests, advance payment requests and expense reports in line with Company's Expense Manuals and flags any noncompliance in a timely manner. Responsible for all accounts payable administrative functions such as invoices matching purchase orders, obtaining approvals and entering the invoices in the accounting system. Review of open purchase orders. Improve quality of information on vendor invoices. Preparation of changes in vendor master data. Requirements Requirements/ Ideal Candidate: Ensures that the daily activities within Individual’s responsibilities are fulfilled properly and timely in accordance with Desktop Procedures and SLA targets. Responds to client/vendor queries in timely manner. Invoice processing is completed within SLA accurately and timely. Invoice Queries are raised in timely manner to vendors/client for resolution. Payments are processed accurately and timely as per agreed SLA. Provides data for internal and external audit. Ensures Month end activities are completed on time for smooth closing of AP subledger. Ensure the errors identified in concurrent audit are rectified in system in timely manner. India market AP experience preferable SAP ERP experience must for the major part of candidate’s experience. Qualifications (Education/Experience/Certification): Bachelor’s degree in accounting and/or Finance preferred. Fluency in English both written and spoken. Minimum 5 years of financial experience for major company or division of large corporation. Previous experience in procure to pay or accounts payable preferred. Hands on experience in SAP must.

title: Manager Logistics
jobDescription: PURPOSE OF THE JOB: § Effective and efficient management of Logistics and supply chain operations resulting in enhanced service levels and optimum spend. Building and managing a robust and agile transportation network Pan India. KEY FOCUS AREAS: · Logistics Spend Management in the area of transport management · Contracting and Transport commercial Management all legs of primary transportation · Ensuring timely availability of trucks for dispatch · Transit Schedule adherence · Statutory compliance in Transportation PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES: Transport Management § Plan, Organize and manage daily operations to ensure efficient and cost-effective transportation of goods. § Finalizing the Transportation Plan Category wise. Ensure that transportation of stocks happen, involving least possible cost but ensuring safety of the stocks. § Lead and facilitate Annual Freight Negotiations for all legs of transportation. Negotiate contracts with carriers and suppliers to secure favorable terms and rates. § Work with the Business on the Network and Budget the Transportation Costs during annual budgeting process. § Develop and implement transportation strategies to optimize routes, reduce costs, and improve service levels. § Analyze transportation costs and provide reports to management with recommendations for cost improvements. § Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscapes, customer needs and emerging technologies to improve transportation processes. Explore the alternative means of transport like rail, multimodal transport, etc., § Develop and implement innovative pricing models considering factors such as operational cost, market demand and customer segmentation. § Monitor and Analyze arrival conditions of stocks at Warehouses/ manufacturing units and develops operating procedures & ensures training to WSP / Transporters to ensure improved delivered quality. § Monitoring and control the actual Transportation spend against the planned budget. § Review and work with MIS team for data analysis, resource optimization and KPI improvements. § Ensure Marketing & Sales team’s queries are resolved on time. § Developing the Vendor base for different warehouse/manufacturing locations. § Develop new transporters for critical routes. § Benchmarking of Freight rates across industry. § Focusing on the Transporter performance and ensure that the following parameters are tracked directly. o Placement Index o On time Delivery o Damages/Losses in Transit o No. of instances of penalty/documentation errors § Provide Tools and expertise to the field Teams on Transportation Optimization through Route Optimization. § Maintain strong relationships with clients, suppliers, and other stakeholders. § Oversee the implementation and use of transportation management systems (TMS) and other relevant technologies. People Development § Identifying the Training needs of the Logistics Team. § Anchoring relevant people processes for developing team members. § Driving the team to deliver superior results and enhancing their capabilities. § Ensuring SAP Training is imparted to all the new entrants in the team and to the WSPs. Code of Conduct and ensuring compliance of statutory norms · Educating team on the prevalent company norms and expected work practices. · Ensuring compliance to all relevant and applicable statutes by reviewing the degree of compliance on a periodical basis. Role Essentials: § Data orientation: Analytics & Advanced Excel- Ability to analyze data and make informed decisions. § Good Hands-On experience of ERPs. Having worked in SAP environment will be an added advantage § Ability to pay close attention and notice minor details § Strong execution skills § Negotiation Skills and experience of collective freight negotiations, eAuction, etc § Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. § Ability to work with multiple stake holders in a fast paced & dynamic environment § Knowledge of transportation regulations and safety standards. INTERNAL LINKAGES: Operations Manager, Finance Manager, Head of Finance, Finance Executives and Manager Warehousing. EXTERNAL LINKAGES: Warehousing service providers, Transporters and Audit Firms Requirements Qualification – Bachelors’ degree in Engineering and Post Graduation from a Tier 1 institute (Preferable) Min 5 Years of relevant experience in field of FMCG/ Retail

jobDescription: The role focuses on strengthening media communication through high‑quality content creation, research, coordination, and cross‑functional collaboration. 1. Media Content Creation Develop impactful long‑form and short‑form content for earned, owned, and co‑created media. Prepare media pitch notes, press releases, briefing notes, responses, comments, and interview talking points. 2. In‑Depth Research & Insight Generation Conduct extensive secondary research on topics such as economic/social issues and sustainability to generate actionable insights and strengthen content. Identify key trends across traditional media, digital platforms, and corporate/brand communication. Perform environment scanning, including peer tracking and analysis. Study ITC initiatives thoroughly by engaging with internal/external experts and field experiences to craft compelling narratives. Leverage AI and relevant technologies for research, stakeholder targeting, impact analysis, and value-adding inputs. 3. Agency Coordination Work with various agencies by creating briefs, defining scope, offering support, and reviewing/bench-marking their output. 4. Media Monitoring & Insights Track, curate, and disseminate media clippings and related insights within the organization. 5. Archival Management Maintain and manage systematic archiving and retrieval of key communications and media assets. 6. Presentation Development Create high-quality presentations for internal and external stakeholders to amplify the company’s messaging. 7. Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with content, digital, and internal communications teams within CCD. Coordinate with multiple ITC businesses/divisions to meet media content needs. Support CCD and other functions in PR events and on-ground media initiatives. Requirements Qualifications & Skills Post Graduate degree, preferably in Mass Communication, English, or Economics from a reputed university. Executive or self-skilling courses in communication, branding, Microsoft Office, or AI (for content). 6–10 years of relevant experience in content creation within PR agencies, journalism (preferably desk roles), or corporate communications in large companies. Excellent writing skills. Strong communication and coordination skills. Thorough understanding of traditional media, new‑age media, multimedia, social media, and influencers. Sharp eye for discovering news. Knowledge of economic, social, and environmental issues. Ability to manage multiple assignments at once and deliver under pressure. Ability to conduct strong secondary research. Proficient in MS Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and relevant AI tools such as ChatGPT, Canva, DALL·E, and Runway. plan figures, reasons for the gap, provide feedback on performance improvement and follow up on the suggestions given for its improvement Capability Building ● To enable staff and team with necessary
